source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 601 and PDF pages 19-20 Civil Service Annuity Deduction, with its examples (federal civil service annuity only); PDF page 17 'Do not enter any other types of pension or retirement income on these lines'; PDF pages 19-24, the Line 11 list, has no other code for this income; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000), line 4 (PDF page 25: 1,000 age 65 or older), line 5 (PDF page 25: 500 age 65 or older and IT-40 line 1 under 40,000, or under 20,000 married filing separately); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = Indiana public pension (PERF) person 0 45,000.00 = 45,000.00. Federal taxable income = 45,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 27,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 45,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 45,000.00 + 0.00 = 45,000.00. Schedule 2: no deductions; line 12 total = 0.00. IT-40 line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 = 45,000.00 - 0.00 = 45,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00; line 5 IT-40 line 1 45,000.00 is not less than 40,000.00: none; line 7 total = 2,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 2,000.00. Line 7 = 45,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 43,000.00. Line 8 = 43,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,290.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,290.00. An Indiana state or local pension is not a federal civil service annuity: no deduction. The booklet has no line for it; it stays in federal AGI.
